faq: Can the app be listed on the Wix App Market?

We build to Wix's developer guidelines so a listing is possible, but Wix reviews and approves every app, and we cannot promise approval. Submitting to the App Market is a separate step we can discuss with you.
Will it only work on my own site?
Basic and Standard are built for your own site. The Premium app is structured so it can be installed on more than one site, which is the base you need if you later want to offer it to others.
Yes. You receive the source code and documentation with the Premium package, and for the other packages the finished widget lives in your site. We keep no rights over the work we deliver to you.
Which Wix tools do you use?
The Wix CLI, Velo and Wix's app and custom element tools, following Wix's own documentation. That keeps the result supported and easy for another developer to take over later.
desc:
Custom Wix apps and widgets add the feature your site is missing, such as a calculator, a product finder or a team dashboard. Ecom Swift LLC builds them with Wix's own developer tools, tests them on a real site and installs them for you.

## What is a custom Wix app or widget?

A custom Wix widget is a piece of functionality you place on a page like any other element, with its own design and its own settings. A custom Wix app is a larger package: it can hold several widgets, a dashboard inside the site owner's account, stored data and connections to outside services. Both are built with Wix's developer tooling, so they behave like native parts of the site instead of pasted code.

## Why build a custom widget instead of working around the gap?

Workarounds pile up. A form that emails a spreadsheet, a manual quote sent by hand and a separate tool for staff all depend on someone remembering to move data between them. Each hand-off is a place where a lead gets lost or a price gets typed wrongly.

A widget that does the job inside the page keeps the visitor on your site and keeps the data in one place. The visitor gets an answer immediately, and you receive a clean record instead of a vague message. Because settings live in the Wix editor, you can change labels, colors and options later without calling a developer.

## How a custom widget affects leads, time and quality

An interactive tool gives visitors a reason to stay and a clear step to take. A calculator turns a vague question about cost into a concrete figure, and a finder narrows a long list of services to the one that fits. Both reduce the number of enquiries that start with basic questions, so the messages you receive are better qualified.

Internally, a dashboard page saves staff time. When requests, settings and stored records appear in one screen, nobody searches inboxes or sheets. The mechanism is simple: fewer manual steps mean fewer mistakes and faster replies. Results still depend on your offer, your traffic and how well the widget fits your visitors' real questions.

## What a well-built Wix app includes

- A widget that fits your site's fonts and colors and responds to the editor's layout controls.
- A settings panel in the Wix editor so you can edit text, options and styles without code.
- A layout checked on desktop and mobile, with touch-friendly controls.
- Backend logic that runs on the server when calculations or stored data are involved.
- Data stored per site, so one installation never mixes with another.
- A test run in a live preview, and where relevant on a separate test site.
- Short instructions, and developer notes with source code for larger builds.

## What we do

We start with a short conversation about the gap on your site: what the visitor does, what should happen next and where the data should go. We then sketch the widget, agree its settings and build it in your own Wix account using Wix's tools.

The Basic package covers one widget with its settings panel. The Standard package adds backend logic, stored data, a dashboard page and one outside connection. The Premium package covers a fuller app with several dashboard pages, per-site settings, a permissions and login flow, and testing on a separate test site. Add-ons such as an extra widget or an install guide video can be added to any of them.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Describe the visitor's goal in one sentence before listing features.
- Keep the first version small and add features once it works.
- Decide who will maintain the settings after launch.
- Provide sample data, price rules or example requests early.
- Test on a phone as well as a computer.

**Avoid:**
- Asking one widget to replace an entire business system.
- Adding fields nobody will read.
- Choosing a custom build where an existing Wix app already solves the problem.
- Skipping error messages for outside connections that can fail.
- Sharing passwords, which we never need.

## Who this service is for

- A service business that wants a quote or estimate tool built around its own pricing logic.
- A shop or catalog owner whose visitors struggle to find the right item among many.
- An agency or team that needs a private page inside the Wix dashboard to review requests.

## What we need from you

Send a short description of the feature, any example screens or competitor tools you like, and the rules the widget must follow, such as pricing tables or required fields. If an outside service is involved, tell us which one and who controls it. We work in your own Wix account, and you add us as a collaborator or developer user, so we never need your password. We reply with questions and a plan after you order, and show you the result before anything goes live.
